tasks.notes: Documents-only amendment of packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0002-servers-and-adapters.md (and spec 0002 only where a listed item needs one sentence). Plan task T12 (CSI edit kinds, read-back helpers and check_model, budget 400, the task cap) was written by B-131 in the worktree <worktrees>/b131 (branch feat/b131-harness-st12-csi-edit-kinds-read, read-only for you): the whole task measures about 621 counted lines; the committed first half (edit kinds and tool port: csi/_edits.py 232, csi/_tools.py 66, CHANGELOG, ratchet) is 301; the second half (read-back and check_model: csi/_checks.py about 282, adapters/_hostport.py about 40) is a draft at <lead>/reports/b131-draft/_checks.py. Read the writer's handoff note <lead>/reports/b131-writer.md and the review record <lead>/reports/b451-review.md (lead findings L1 to L4 of the T11b review). Lead decision D-12: split, never stretch. Make these edits: (1) Split T12 into T12 (edit kinds and tool port, AC25, AC26) and T12b (read-back and check_model, AC24), as the writer proposed: own files, tests_first inside each task (TF008), covers keeping every acceptance criterion of the old T12 (GC016), budgets from the measured content plus about 10 percent (each at most 380), T12b depends_on T12, T13 and every task that depended on T12 now depend on T12b, the shared-file list of plan section 1 updated, YAML amendment comments (B-465). T12b will be work item B-466. (2) Per-tool units token: the writer found that AdapterToolPort fixes one units_system per Binding, so the wall-thickness token kN_mm_C and the load token kN_m_C cannot both be sent, and worked around it with a context variable and a wrapping binder because adapters/_toolport.py is not in T12's files. Decide from spec 0002 and the code which is right: if the clean fix (the binder is given the tool or its descriptor) is small, add adapters/_toolport.py and its test file to T12's files and say in the T12 prose that the workaround is replaced by it; keep T12 within budget. (3) T12b files += the product module that holds unconfirmed host facts (packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/adapters/csi/products/_etabs.py or wherever spec 0002 puts table names and columns), so the read-back table keys and columns live there flagged with OQ-G10 and not as constants in _checks.py. (4) Give each carried finding a home in exactly one task's prose and files, without designing new behaviour: the empty SavedModel.fingerprint after save (needs adapters/_identity.py and a T10 test; T12b or T19), the call of AdapterHostPort.wrote(key) after each adapter write and the draining of take_warnings() (T12b), the T11 mappers in csi/_replies.py raising a bare KeyError or a pydantic ValidationError instead of UNEXPECTED_REPLY (T13 lists _replies.py: confirm), the wall-thickness table missing from the spec 4.6.4 read set against AC27 (spec sentence or a local-testing note, whichever the spec's own rules ask). (5) Two points the writer could not settle from the spec: where check_model's read-back tolerance comes from (it has no tolerance parameter and the value must not be a constant: find what spec 0002, the engine spec HostPort and calcs spec 0003 section 4.4 say; if the documents already answer it, cite the sentence in the T12b prose; if they do not, do NOT decide it: list it in your summary as an owner question with a recommendation), and whether combination factors (scale_ratio, called an engineering quantity in spec 4.6.2) may be literals inside the contract's CombinationItem or must be references (same rule: cite or queue as an owner question). Keep to these edits (D-28). The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.
